title: Social Media Content Creator & DM Conversion VA — Health & Wellness Brand
description:
About the Practice

First In Osteopractic Wellness is a cash-based physical therapy clinic in Putnam, Connecticut, USA. Dr. Jared is a fellowship-trained, Army veteran physical therapist. We run one premium offer — a 90-day protocol — and we do not take insurance. Every session is 60 minutes, 1-on-1, with a purpose.



We are growing fast and need a sharp VA to edit our video content, run our social media, and turn online conversations into booked discovery calls.



This Role Has Three Core Pillars

All three are primary responsibilities — not one above the others. Do not apply if you are only strong in one area.



PILLAR 1 — VIDEO EDITING

Receive raw short-form and long-form footage from Dr. Jared and edit into platform-ready content

Edit short-form videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) with strong hooks, precise cuts, and platform-optimized pacing

Edit long-form content (workshops, injury screens, educational sessions) for YouTube and

Add captions, subtitles, and branded on-screen text to every video — required on all content without exception

Deliver content that is platform-spec compliant and post-ready without revision rounds

Primary tool: CapCut Pro — proficiency required



PILLAR 2 — CONTENT POSTING, CAPTION WRITING, REPURPOSING & PAID ADS

Instagram: 3–5 posts per week — Reels, carousels, and static content

: 1–2 posts per day

TikTok: 2–3 posts per day

-Leverage AI tools and content repurposing to maximize output from every piece of raw footage

-Write captions in Dr. Jared’s established voice using provided frameworks and brand guidelines

-Reply to all comments and story interactions daily to build community and trust

-Run and manage paid ad campaigns on
 and Instagram — create ad copy and creative, set targeting, monitor performance, and optimize based on results

-Familiarity with ManyChat — you do not need to build flows, but you must understand how automated DM sequences work so you can pick up conversations where automation leaves off and move leads toward a booked discovery call



PILLAR 3 — DM MANAGEMENT & DISCOVERY CALL CONVERSION

-Run daily proactive DM outreach to warm audiences and avatar-matched profiles

-Manage inbound DM conversations, qualify leads, and move qualified prospects to book a 15-minute discovery call

-Submit a weekly performance report every Friday tracking videos delivered, reach, DMs sent, calls booked, and paid ad spend vs. results



What This Role Is NOT

You are not building strategy from scratch — Dr. Jared owns strategy. You execute it.

You are not managing the GHL/CRM backend — a separate tech VA handles that.

You are not filming content — raw footage is provided to you by Dr. Jared.



Compensation

Performance bonus: $25 per qualified discovery call that is booked by you and shows up — paid monthly based on verified showed calls in GHL

What this looks like at goal: 15 showed calls/month = $375 in bonus on top of base — total earning potential $975–$1,200/month

Content creation is your primary job — DM conversion is the bonus lane. Strong performers in both will earn at the top of this range consistently

-Paid ads experience required — proven ability to set up, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a service-based business; health and wellness ad experience is a strong advantage

-++ IMPORTANT++ Respond with OSTEO as subject / opening line of message+++ Applications without this will not be reviewed. 

-Experience running DM outreach campaigns for a service-based business

Available for at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)

title: Bookkeeping/Accountant for Aus Construction Company
description:
Role Overview

This is a full-time, remote bookkeeping/accountant role supporting a fast-growing NSW-based construction and project management firm operating across private residential, government housing, and manufacturing divisions.



The primary focus of this role is financial ownership — taking control of Xero, reconciliation, payroll, invoicing, and cross-entity cost allocation so the business owner can step back from daily financial tasks and operate at CEO level.



This is not a generalist VA role with bookkeeping bolted on. The financial function is the core, with reporting and operational support built around it. The right person will be very analytically strong, proactively autonomous, and capable of growing into a financial reporting function over time.



Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time Virtual Tea
mber

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Working Hours: 7:00am – 4:00pm AEST





What Success Looks Like

Within the first 30–60 days, success in this role looks like:



The director opens a weekly report and has a clear picture of every project's financial and operational status — without digging for the data himself.

Reconciliation, payroll, and invoicing are handled accurately and on time, every week.

A financial dashboard is built and maintained across all active projects.

Red flags — budget depletion without milestone completion, cost overruns, allocation errors — are surfaced proactively before the director notices them.

SOPs are documented as each task is handed over, building a reliable knowledge base.



Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Bookkeeping

Daily bank reconciliation in Xero across all entities

Invoice management: review, allocate and confirm drafts from project management platforms into Xero

Weekly payroll processing for permanent and ad hoc staff

Weekly supplier payments, transitioning from daily to weekly pay runs

Cross-entity expense allocation across residential, remedial and government business lines

BAS and IAS preparation each quarter

Quarterly Xero business line review to catch misallocations across three tracking codes

Monthly P&L compilation

Ad hoc quoting and tender documentation support



Reporting & Financial Dashboard

Build and maintain a weekly financial dashboard across all active projects: contract sum, current costs, forecasted costs and variances

Weekly cash flow reporting and monthly detailed cash flow comparisons (month-on-month and year-on-year)

Cash flow projection modelling including milestone impact scenarios

Extract and compile schedule and progress data for the director's weekly project overview

Proactively flag red flags: budget depletion without milestone completion, cost overruns, allocation errors



Day-to-Day Communication & Task Management

Send a morning WhatsApp message with priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report covering completed tasks, work in progress, and items requiring the director's attention or approval

Manage and maintain the Trello task board across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Assist with scheduling integration through Motion

Maintain a 'car park' list — capturing ideas and medium-term goals raised by the director for follow-up at the right time



Operational & Administrative Support

Project administration: building contracts and paperwork for project commencement and completion

Insurance management: maintaining and renewing workers compensation, vehicle, and business insurance policies

OneDrive document management: updating job folders with revised plans, specs, or documents

Permit and application form completion as directed (ad hoc)

Liaise with the Project Coordinator during the transition period as tasks are handed over

Document SOPs in the handbook as each task is handed over

Occasional external contact with certifiers and suppliers via
 and phone when directed

Legacy data extraction from prior system as required during the transition period



Technology Stack



Xero: Primary accounting — reconciliation, payroll, BAS/IAS, batch payments, financial reporting (mandatory, high proficiency required)

WunderBuild: Residential project management: invoicing, scheduling (training provided)

Plexa: Government project management: invoicing, financials, AI invoice scanning; integrates with Xero 

OneDrive: Document management and job folder storage

Trello: Task and workflow management across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Motion: Director's scheduling and note management tool

WhatsApp: Primary day-to-day communication: morning messages and task clarifications

 (Outlook): Formal communication and end-of-day reports





Qualifications & Experience

Essential

Strong bookkeeping background with hands-on Australian Xero experience — non-negotiable

Familiarity with Australian tax obligations: BAS, IAS, payroll, and GST allocation

Comfortable managing financial complexity across multiple entities or business lines

Analytically strong — capable of building dashboards and reports from raw platform data

Understands project-based financials: milestone tracking, budget vs actuals, cost forecasting

Proactive communicator with strong written and verbal English

Able to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment without daily direction



Preferred

Construction or trades industry exposure — fast learning of industry-specific platforms is essential if not

Degree in accounting or finance (not mandatory if competence is clearly demonstrated)

Experience with Excel for dashboards and reporting

Prior familiarity with WunderBuild or similar construction project management platforms



Who You Are

The person who thrives in this role will recognise themselves in most of the following:



Analytical Thinker — you go beyond processing data to interpreting it. You spot patterns, flag anomalies and ask why when something looks off.

Proactively Autonomous — you don't wait to be told what to do next. You work through your task list and communicate progress without needing to be chased.

Detail-Obsessed — you catch the small things: the misallocated invoice, the GST error, the milestone not ticked but the budget almost gone.

Fast Learner — you pick up new platforms and processes quickly and don't need hand-holding once shown.

Calm Communicator — you can keep pace with a fast-moving, ideas-driven director without getting flustered. You ask the right questions to get clarity.

Systems Builder — you naturally document what you do. You see the value in SOPs and contribute to them without being asked.

Commercially Aware — you understand that the numbers you manage represent real projects, real deadlines, and real consequences.

Reliable Under Routine — you handle repetitive financial tasks with consistent accuracy and never treat routine as low priority.

Initiative-Taker — you don't just tick tasks. You see what's coming, prepare for it, and surface things the director doesn't yet know he needs to know.

Discreet and Trustworthy — you will have access to sensitive financial data across multiple entities and partnership structures. Confidentiality is non-negotiable.



Important Notes for Applicants

A few things to be aware of before applying:



This business operates across multiple entities (residential, remedial, and government), each with separate Xero tracking codes and, in some cases, separate bank accounts. Cross-entity cost allocation is a core task from day one. You must be comfortable managing this complexity.

The director is direct, fast-moving, and high-achieving. He will respond well to someone who pushes back constructively, asks the obvious question, and shows initiative. A passive or overly deferential approach will not be a good fit.

This is not a task-ticking role. We are looking for someone who creates tasks as much as completes them.

The director generates ideas and instructions quickly, not always framed as formal tasks. Capturing everything, distinguishing between 'idea I just had' and 'immediate action', and flagging medium-term items is a core part of the job.

Red flag identification — recognising signals like a milestone not completed but the budget nearly depleted — is a trained skill, not a day-one expectation. However, the analytical mindset and commercial awareness to get there must already exist.

- 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM EST (morning)

- 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST (evening)



You should be ready to take either shift depending on what the team needs that week.



---

Your day breaks into two modes:



Mode 1 — Hunt



New leads come in hot. You call them within 60 seconds. Not 90. Not 2 minutes. Sixty seconds. You'll be working leads across several med spa clients at once, using GoHighLevel, Slack, and our internal tools to stay organized.

You'll run our proven C.L.O.S.E.R. script — exactly as written, but in your own natural voice. You'll uncover what the lead actually wants, pinpoint what's holding them back, present the offer that fits, and handle pushback like a pro. Then you lock in the appointment so they actually show.

- Every fresh lead is contacted in under a minute

- The script flows naturally — no robotic delivery

- You're following up religiously and treating each lead like a real human, not a number

- **Extra bonuses:**

  - Up to +$500 USD/month from performance challenges

Most solid performers land around **$1,500 USD/month**. Top performers go higher.



We pay for results. The math is straightforward.



---

Must-Haves (No Exceptions):



- Can work EST shifts including weekends

- Clear, confident English with a neutral accent that sounds natural to US callers

- Internet at 100 Mbps or faster — plus backup power

- Quiet space to work, free of background noise

- Good headset

- Laptop + a large monitor



---



Nice to Have:



Past experience in appointment setting, call center work, sales, or high-volume support gives you a head start. But honestly? We've seen people with zero experience outperform veterans because they were coachable and hungry. That matters more.



---



Tools We Use Daily



- GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Slack



---



What You'll Get From Us



- A full training playbook so you're never guessing

- Week 1 packed with script drills, roleplays, and call reviews

- A complete Appointment Setter Handbook

- Ongoing coaching designed to make you better and richer over time



---



Who Actually Makes It Here?



People who:



- Show up every day and put in the reps

- Hear feedback and apply it immediately

- View this as their career — not a temporary gig



---



**How to Apply**



Head to (
) and record a short voice message answering three things:



1. Why are you the right fit for this role?

2. What relevant experience do you have? 

3. What's a personal goal you're working toward right now?



Submit the link. If your voice and energy stand out, we'll be in touch.

title: Video Editor For 1.4M Youtuber — Long-Form YouTube Vlogs
description:
Type: Full-time



Salary: $500 to $800 per month (USD), based on your speed and skill. Raises as you prove yourself.



Schedule: Flexible. What matters most is that you finish each video quickly with utmost quality.



About me

I am a YouTuber with more than 1.4 million subscribers. I make long videos that tell a story. 



Each video is planned out with a full script, and most of it is me talking over the footage. The story and the editing are what make the video fun to watch.



My goal is to post one new video every day. That is a lot of work for one person, so I am splitting the editing into two steps. The first step is the rough cut. The second step is the final polish. This job is for the first step, the rough cut.



What you will do



Each day, I record one long video of myself talking. 



It is usually about 20 minutes long. I read from a full script while I record. Your job is to take that long, messy video and turn it into a clean, short version that my senior editor can finish. 



Here is what that means:



I will send you the 20-minute video plus the script I read from.



About 40 percent of the video is mistakes. I will mess up words, start over, and say things wrong. You need to cut all of these out so only the good parts are left.



About 20 percent of the video is correct but not needed. Sometimes I say the same thing twice. Sometimes a line sounds fine alone but does not fit once you watch the whole video. You need to find these lines and cut them too. This is the hardest part of the job, and it is the main skill I am hiring for.



Put the good clips in the right order so the story flows well. There should be no long pauses and no boring parts.



Mark the spots where extra footage (B-roll) should go. My senior editor will pick the final footage. You just point out where it belongs.



Hand me a clean video that is ready for music, sound, text, and final touches.



You will not do the final polish at first. Eg. You will not pick the final B-roll, add text, or choose the music and sound. Over time, will add that to your deliverables. My senior editor does that part and will train you to do it overtime. 



Your job is to take a long, messy video and make it short and clean. If you do this well and fast, you can earn more over time. 



What I am looking for



Good cutting choices. You can watch a clip and quickly tell if it is good, a mistake, or repeated. This matters more than fancy effects.



Speed and focus. I post every day, so you need to work through long videos fast without dropping in quality.



A good sense of timing. You can tell when a cut feels slow and when it feels just right.



You are reliable. I need to send you a video every day and trust that it comes back done.



You are fast in an editing program you like (Premiere Pro - preferred, DaVinci, CapCut, Final Cut, or any other).



Nice to have, but not required: experience editing long videos, talking-style videos, or content for creators. I want you to be able to learn who I am and my videos. 



How to apply

Please read these steps carefully. Most people will not, and that helps me find the people who do.



Start your message with the word FLOWSTATE. This tells me you read the whole post. If you do not include it, I will not read your message.



Send me your portfolio. Share 2 or 3 examples of long videos or talking-style videos you have edited. 



If you make my short list, I will send you a test edit. I will give you a short video and its script, and you will make a rough cut. This is the real test. If your choices match the way I would edit, you are hired.



I look forward to seeing your work!

s, live chat, and text messages

mbers and report to the superiors

s

title: Hiring Operations Manager ASAP
description:
About the Role

Gold Side Agency is looking for a driven, sharp and hungry Operations Manager to grow with us. We are a marketing company that delivers exclusive, pre-qualified estimates to contractors across the U.S. We run paid ads on Meta, manage full client fulfillment and are scaling fast.



We are not looking for someone who already has everything figured out. We are looking for someone who has some experience in operations, marketing, or client management — someone who understands how businesses work and has worked in a related capacity before. What we want on top of that is the right mind — someone who thinks on their feet, takes full ownership, spots problems before being told and builds solutions independently.



What You'll Own and Who We're Looking For

All trainings and SOPs will be provided for everything in this role. If you don't know how to do something, the SOP already exists. Your job is to learn it fast, execute it consistently and improve it where you see gaps. What we cannot teach is drive, critical thinking and the ability to own a result without being managed.



- Client fulfillment — You will oversee ad account performance inside Meta Ads Manager, manage client pipelines and lead follow-up inside GoHighLevel end to end. We need someone who has at least a basic understanding of how paid ads or CRM tools work, even if not at an expert level yet

- Building and improving SOPs — Every process in this business needs to be documented clearly enough that any new hire can follow it from day one. You build those, maintain them and improve them constantly. We need someone who naturally thinks in systems

- Monitoring performance — You track KPIs across all departments, identify what's underperforming and take action immediately. You don't wait to be told something is broken — you see it, flag it and fix it

- Managing the team as we grow — You will onboard new hires, train them into our systems and hold them accountable to output. We need someone who has managed or coordinated with other people before

- Proactive problem solving — You spot problems before they become client problems. You build the solution, present it to the CEO for a green light and then execute. The CEO approves, you own the outcome

- Daily closed-loop reporting — Every task has a status. Every problem is flagged the 
nt it appears. Nothing falls through the cracks

- Responsiveness — Every message gets acknowledged immediately during work hours. Not hours later, not in the EOD report — right then





This Role Is NOT For You If:

- You have zero experience in operations, marketing, client management or any related field — we are looking for potential plus some foundation, not an absolute beginner

- You need to be told what to do next — this role requires you to think ahead and bring solutions, not wait for instructions

- You go quiet when things get busy — every message gets acknowledged immediately during work hours, no exceptions

- You treat SOPs as someone else's job — building and improving systems is a core part of what you own here

- You get defensive when held accountable — we are direct, we move fast and we expect the same in return

- You are looking for a task-execution role — if you need a checklist handed to you every day this is not the right fit



How to Apply:

Apply for the Chief Operating Officer position here: 
/hiring-positions



Once you've completed the application we'll review your responses. If you're a fit you will receive an
 with the next steps.



Compensation

This is not a flat rate forever. $4.50/hour to start — 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday. As you perform and as the company grows, your pay grows with it. Our target range for this role as the business scales is $6–$12/hour with much longer hours — your output and ownership directly determine how fast you get there. We take care of people who take care of the business.

title: WordPress Webmaster & Tech Support – $180 AUD/mo Retainer (Part-Time / Stable)
description:
About Us:

Mike’s Clean Freaks is a premium, subscription-only residential cleaning service based in Perth, Western Australia. We don’t do one-time cleans or exit cleans; we only service recurring, premium clients. Our website is our digital storefront, and after a past hacking i
, security, speed, and technical stability are our absolute top priorities.



We are not looking for an SEO strategist or a Google Ads manager. We are looking for a reliable, highly technical WordPress Webmaster to keep our site secure, fast, healthy, and technically optimized.



What You Will Do (Up to 8 Hours per Month):

- Security First: Maintain firewalls, monitor for malware, and ensure daily external backups are running flawlessly so we are 100% hack-proof.

- Updates & Testing: Keep WordPress core, themes, and plugins updated safely (using a staging environment when necessary to avoid breaking the live site).

- Speed & Performance: Monitor and optimize mobile and desktop page speeds for the Perth market.

- Technical SEO Support: Maintain clean site architecture, fix broken links, manage redirects, and ensure our XML sitemaps are correctly serving Google and AI search engines.

- Minor Tweaks: Handle occasional layout adjustments, text changes, or image swaps as requested.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
Job Title: Part-Time Cold Caller – Real Estate Lead Qualification (Remote)



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred)

Hours: 15-20 hours/week (flexible schedule)

Pay: $4-6/hour depending on experience and English fluency

Start: Immediate



About the Role



I own a real estate investment company focused on distressed and inherited properties. I need someone to call homeowners from my lead lists, confirm basic information, gauge interest, and set appointments for me to follow up.



This is NOT high-pressure sales. Every call is about gathering data and finding people who are open to a conversation — nothing more. You will have a clear script, a list of property owners, and a simple goal: confirm the right person, pick the right approach, book the call.



Your Responsibilities



- Call 30-50 homeowners per day from provided lists

- Confirm you're speaking to the right person (owner, heir, executor, etc.)

- Deliver a short, natural script based on the situation

- Identify and remove dead/bad numbers from the list

- Log call outcomes (not interested, callback booked, wrong number, etc.)

- Book appointments for me to call back



What I'm Looking For



- Natural, conversational English that doesn't sound like a script

- Comfortable talking to strangers on the phone

- Able to handle rejection without getting discouraged

- Reliable internet connection and quiet environment for calls

- No prior sales experience required — right attitude and excellent English matters more



How to Apply



Do NOT send a generic resume. Instead:



1. Record a 30-60 second voice clip of you reading this script like you're calling a real person:



"Hi, is this William? ... Hey William, this is [your name] — I was looking up some property records and your name came up connected to 518 Harrison Ave. Are you still involved with that property?"



(Substitute any name/address — this is just to hear your voice.)



2. Send the recording with a short message about why this job interests you.



If your recording sounds natural and conversational, I'll reach out for a quick chat. If it sounds like you're reading from a script, I'll pass.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Photo Editor — Wedding Photography (Remote / Part-Time)
description:
We are a photo editing studio that works exclusively with professional wedding photographers. We edit large volumes of wedding images inside Adobe Lightroom — culling, colour grading, and quality checking — so our clients can spend less time at their desk and more time doing what they love.



This is a remote, part-time role. You will receive jobs via a shared workspace, complete your edits, and return the finished Lightroom catalog within the agreed deadline. Work volume will grow as we take on more clients.



This is recurring work.

This is not a one-off project. We are looking for editors who want ongoing, regular work.

As our client base grows, so does the number of jobs available. Reliable editors will receive more work.

We are building a long-term team — not a one-job arrangement.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Cull wedding galleries in Adobe Lightroom — selecting the best images to hit a client-specified target range

- Apply AI-generated colour grades and check every image for consistency

- QC your own work before delivery — flag any issues rather than guessing

- Communicate clearly via Google Chat when a job is ready or if there is a problem

- Follow the Selects Co Standard Operating Procedure for every job, every time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Lightroom experience - Minimum 5 years working in Adobe Lightroom Classic

Wedding photography knowledge - Understanding of wedding day flow — ceremony, reception, portraits — so you can cull with context

Attention to detail - You care about consistency across an entire gallery, not just individual images

Reliability - You meet deadlines. If something comes up, you communicate early — not at the last minute

English communication - You can write a clear, professional message in English

Internet connection - Stable enough to upload and download Lightroom catalogs (no RAW files — catalog + Smart Previews only)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Imagen AI or similar AI editing tools

- Previous experience editing for a photography studio or business (not just personal work)

- Familiarity with wedding photography styles — film, editorial, documentary



PAY

Pay is per job, not per hour. Rate is based on image bracket size. Rates will be confirmed with you before your first live job. You will be paid reliably and on time.



Note for applicants

Before being offered a paid job, all editors complete a short paid test edit so we can check the quality of your work and how well you follow instructions.

We do not expect perfection — we expect honesty, effort, and the ability to follow a brief.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us a message with the following:



WHAT TO INCLUDE

1. A brief introduction — who you are and where you're based

2. How long you have been editing wedding photography in Lightroom

3. Whether you have edited for a studio or business before (or if this would be your first time)

4. What your internet connection is like and whether you can upload/download large files reliably

5. Any questions you have about the role.



You do not need to send a portfolio at this stage. We will ask for that if we invite you to the test stage.

title: App Developer
description:
iOS Developer Needed — Sleep Score Social Leaderboard App (Snooze)



Looking for an experienced iOS developer to build Snooze — a SwiftUI app that passively reads Apple Watch Sleep Score from HealthKit and turns it into a friend group leaderboard. Think StepUp but for sleep. No manual input. Fully automatic.



---



WHAT YOU'RE BUILDING



Snooze reads a user's nightly Apple Watch Sleep Score (0–100) via HealthKit in the background and posts it to a Supabase leaderboard shared with their friend group. Users wake up, open the app, and see where they ranked overnight. The core loop is: sleep ? score syncs automatically ? check your rank ? trash talk your friends.



---



PHASE 0 (Week 1 — must complete before anything else)



Validate that Apple Watch Sleep Score (the computed 0–100 metric) is accessible via HealthKit API. Build a single-screen prototype on a real device that reads last night's score. If the score isn't directly queryable, evaluate computing it from raw sleep stages. Do not proceed to Phase 1 without this confirmed working.



---



FULL SCOPE



Phase 1 — Core App (2–3 weeks)

- Sign in with Apple +
 (Supabase Auth)

- HealthKit sleep score read with background delivery entitlement

- Friend groups — invite by contact/username

- Leaderboard — ranked by last night's score, 7-day rolling average

- Morning push notifications — score ready + rank alerts



Phase 2 — App Store Ready (1–2 weeks)

- PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, all HealthKit usage descriptions

- App icon, screenshots, App Store Connect metadata

- Crash reporting (Crashlytics or Sentry)

- Proper error states (Watch not paired, Sleep tracking off, no data)



Phase 3 — Monetization + Corporate (2–3 weeks)

- RevenueCat + StoreKit 2 freemium paywall

- Corporate group flow — admin creates group, employees join via code

- Historical trends (paid feature)

- Trash talk / reactions on leaderboard



---



TECH STACK



- Swift / SwiftUI (pure SwiftUI, no UIKit)

- HealthKit (background delivery entitlement required)

- Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Realtime, Edge Functions)

- RevenueCat + StoreKit 2

- APNs push notifications

- iOS 17+ / watchOS 10+ minimum



A full developer handoff document is ready — architecture, database schema, file structure, phased roadmap, and known risks are all documented. You'll hit the ground running.



---



IDEAL CANDIDATE



- 3+ years iOS/SwiftUI experience

- Prior HealthKit integration (sleep or fitness data strongly preferred)

- Supabase or Firebase backend experience

- Has shipped at least one app to the App Store

- Can show portfolio of consumer iOS apps



---



ENGAGEMENT



- Start with Phase 0 validation (fixed price, 3–5 days)

- Full build contingent on Phase 0 success

- Open to milestone-based fixed price or hourly

- US-based or overlap with Pacific Time preferred



To apply: share 1–2 relevant iOS apps you've shipped, confirm you have an Apple Watch to test HealthKit sleep data, and tell me in one sentence why sleep score is a better social metric than steps.

title: Consumer Law & Credit Dispute Representative
description:
We are looking for a knowledgeable and detail-oriented Consumer Law & Credit Dispute Representative to help our clients protect their rights under federal and state consumer protection laws. You will work directly with clients to identify inaccurate, unfair, or unverifiable information on their credit reports and develop customized dispute strategies to resolve them.

This is not just a credit repair role — you are an advocate for consumer rights and financial freedom.



What You’ll Do

• Review client credit reports from all three major bureaus (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion)

• Identify violations of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), and other applicable consumer protection laws

• Draft and send dispute letters to credit bureaus, creditors, and debt collectors on behalf of clients

• Create customized dispute strategies tailored to each client’s credit profile

• Track dispute outcomes and follow up as needed

• Communicate updates and results clearly to clients

• Maintain accurate records and documentation throughout the dispute process



Requirements

• Solid understanding of consumer protection laws, including FCRA, FDCPA, and TILA

• Experience with credit dispute processes and bureau communication

• Strong written communication skills — dispute letters must be clear, professional, and legally sound

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple client cases simultaneously

• Experience working with clients in a professional, empathetic manner

You can find my page on Instagram and

Strong storytelling structure (clean speech, no filler words, seamless scene flow)

Ability to match and enhance brand identity through editing

Colour grading, sound design, and motion graphics experience is a plus

BONUS: If you understand comedic timing, let me know!



The Role & Workload:

20+ edits/month (short & long-form) with 48-hour turnaround for short-form, 5 days for long-form

Opportunity to grow into a full-time role with regular projects

Collaborative and creative team culture.

Your answer:



4. It is Tuesday. Our last four Shorts have all flatlined — under 5,000 views each. You have a clean schedule until Friday. You have noticed three formats, edits, or sounds that have been working on competitor accounts in the last 30 days. Which one do you steal, and how do you cut it for us so it does not feel forced or late?

Your answer:

Your answer:



6. It is 11 AM Wednesday. Something has just happened in our space — a viral moment a smart editor could ride. We have raw footage from a recent shoot that could speak to it. I'm in meetings until 2 PM. What do you do between now and 2 PM?

I message you: "I want our next five Shorts to use [a specific style — a motion-graphics technique, a retention-edit pattern, a colour grade, anything] that you have never used before. Can you have one ready by Friday?" Walk us through your week, Monday morning to Friday delivery.

Your answer:



8. It is day 90 in this new role. I ask you: "What is the one thing you have changed about how we make shorts that is directly responsible for our growth this quarter?" What do you say?

Your answer:



9 Look at our last 10 published pieces of content (links provided separately). Pick the one you think is the worst and tell us — frame by frame if you have to — what is broken about it. Don't be polite. Be helpful.

Your answer:



10. It is 2 PM Wednesday. I message you: "Use this song for the next three Shorts — it's blowing up." You listen to it. It does not fit our brand and it is already six weeks past peak. I’m excited. What is the actual conversation you have, today, before you start cutting?

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
# Video Editor, Full-Time | Throttle Bros

???? Remote | $1,500/month + Performance Bonuses



---



## About Us



Throttle Bros is a fast-growing motorsports YouTube channel built around motorsports, e-motos, and the culture of riding. We create weekly long-form videos and a steady stream of short-form content across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. We're a small, tight team that moves fast and puts out content we're genuinely proud of.



---



## The Role



We're looking for a full-time video editor who understands, at a deep level, how to structure a YouTube video that people actually watch all the way through. Not just cutting clips together, but engineering retention. That means a hook that grabs in the first 30 seconds, open loops planted throughout the video that make the viewer feel like they can't leave yet, and a story arc that pays off at the end of a 30-minute video.



You'll take raw footage and deliver a near-final edit with minimal direction. Color grade, audio mix, sound design, music, pacing, structure, all of it. Then hand it to us for a final pass and voiceover. The goal is for your edit to need as little back-and-forth as possible, and over time, as you learn the style, get closer and closer to publish-ready every week.



---



## Weekly Deliverables



- One 30-45 minute, long-form YouTube video edited to near-final cut

- Craft a compelling hook in the opening 30 seconds that earns the watch

- Build and plant open loops throughout the video that keep viewers from clicking away

- Structure a clear story arc with a payoff that makes the full runtime feel worth it

- Lay in music, handle audio mixing and sound design, apply color grade

- Deliver a clean edit ready for a final pass and voiceover drop-in

- 7-14 short-form clips per week pulled from the long-form timeline, each one reformatted for vertical composition and edited as a standalone piece with its own hook, pacing, and flow, ready to post to Shorts, Reels, and TikTok



The short-form clips aren't just crops. You're identifying the best moments in the long-form video, pulling them into their own timelines, adjusting composition for vertical, and editing each one to work as a self-contained piece of content.



---



## This Role Is NOT For You If



- You think a good edit is just clean cuts and good color

- You've never thought about why a viewer would stop watching at the 8-minute mark

- You need a lot of direction to figure out what the story is

- You treat short-form as an afterthought



---



## What We're Looking For



- Deep understanding of YouTube retention structure: hooks, open loops, story arcs, and payoff

- Knows how to identify and shape short-form moments that stop the scroll

- Proficient in DaVinci Resolve, this is non-negotiable

- Strong instincts for pacing in long-form content, specifically 20 to 35-minute videos

- Action sports, motorsports, or outdoor/adventure editing experience is a big plus

- Self-directed, hits deadlines, and communicates proactively

- Has a portfolio or reel that demonstrates retention-focused editing, not just pretty cuts



---



## Compensation



- $1,500/month, paid as an independent contractor (1099)

- $100 bonus for every long-form video that hits 100,000 views.

- $100 bonus for every short-form clip you edited that crosses 1,000,000 views.

- Remote, flexible hours, you own your schedule

- Weekly deliverable: one long-form edit plus 14 short-form clips, every week



The bonus structure is real. If you're consistently editing videos that perform, this pays significantly more than the base. The base pay can also increase over time. 



*You will be responsible for your own taxes as an independent contractor.*



---



## Check Out Our Content



Before applying, take a look at what we make so you know exactly what you're signing up for:



- YouTube: 

- Instagram: 



---



## To Apply



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line "Video Editor Application." In your
 include:



- A short intro and why you want this job

- Why you think you'd be a great fit for Throttle Bros specifically

- Links to videos you have edited yourself



Applications without work samples will not be considered.

title: Airbnb STR Virtual Assistant Manager
description:

The ideal candidate will take ownership of overseeing the current VA team, assisting them when needed, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.



This is a full-time position requiring a 50-hour workweek - 10 hours per day, 5 days per week (Thu-Mon), 11am-9pm PT, but you are required to stand by between 9-11pm in case of urgent cases. The role requires availability for evening, night, and weekend work as operational needs dictate. All tasks must be completed personally. Delegating work to sub-VAs is strictly prohibited.



Team Management

- Supervise, support, and mentor a growing team of 3 Virtual Assistants handling guest communication and daily operations.

- Monitor team performance and ensure standards are met (response rate, resolution quality, guest satisfaction, task completion, etc).

- Conduct regular check-ins, performance reviews, and lead weekly tea
etings.

Operational Oversight

- Manage escalation issues and support VAs with complex guest situations.

- Assist with administrative tasks such as but not limited to relistings, updating listings, outreaching for vendors (handyman, cleaners, lawn maintenance, etc), and other tasks.

- Coordinate with maintenance, cleaning, and other vendors as needed.

- Ensure SOPs are followed and updated as needed.

Operational & Performance Improvements

- Monitor account health, listing performance, and revenue to identify issues and improvement opportunities.

- Track guest messages, reviews, tickets, and tasks to ensure timely follow-up.

- Identify recurring problems and implement process improvements.

- Lead expansion efforts for new OTAs and direct-booking channels.



Scheduling & Resource Management

- Manage VA work schedules to ensure coverage across time zones and peak periods.

- Track attendance, productivity, and workload distribution.

- Assist with onboarding and training of new VAs as the team grows.



Qualifications

- Proven experience with Airbnb, VRBO, Bookings, or other short-term rental platforms.

- Prior experience managing or supervising a VA team is strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with Hostaway and Pricelabs property management software is required.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Strong organizational skills with great attention to detail.

- Ability to problem-solve and handle multiple tasks under pressure.

- Experience working across different time zones is a plus.

title: Social Media Manager / Growth Lead for an International Spiritual / Self-Reflection Brand Ecosystem
description:
We are looking for a Social Media Manager / Growth Lead to help us build and manage several connected social media profiles for a new international project in the space of spirituality, self-reflection, symbolic self-knowledge, emotional closure, personal intention and inner peace.



This is not a simple posting job.



We are looking for someone who can think strategically, create content, organize the process, test different content angles, analyze performance and help us build a real audience from zero.



The project is currently in an early validation stage, but it has much larger international potential. We are looking for someone who can treat this as a serious growth opportunity, not just another small freelance task.



General Profile Themes



The profiles will be connected to several related themes, including:



* deeper symbolic self-knowledge,

* sidereal / Vedic-inspired astrology,

* the difference between popular zodiac signs and a deeper symbolic view of the birth date,

* karmic patterns and life path reflection,

* forgiveness, emotional closure and unsaid words,

* reflective letters, intention work and relationship release,

* daily intentions, inner peace, compassion and simple spiritual practices.



We are not publicly sharing the full brand structure at this stage. Detailed names, brand direction and the full brief will be shared only with selected candidates after confidentiality documents are signed.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* has real experience managing social media profiles,

* can create content in English,

* understands spirituality, reflection, symbolism and emotional content,

* can write hooks, scripts and captions,

* can create or coordinate graphics, carousels and short-form videos,

* can plan weekly and monthly content,

* can manage community engagement,

* can analyze results and recommend improvements,

* can work independently without constant supervision,

* communicates quickly and reliably,

* can manage several profiles as one connected ecosystem while keeping each profile distinct,

* is ready to treat the project as a serious long-term opportunity.



Very important: we need someone fully engaged. If you are unavailable during weekends, certain days or specific hours, we expect clear communication in advance.



Role Scope



The selected person may be responsible for:



* social media strategy for several connected profiles,

* positioning and differentiation of each profile,

* consistency of the full content ecosystem,

* weekly content plans,

* hooks, scripts and captions,

* short-form video direction,

* carousels and graphic concepts,

* posting and scheduling,

* community management,

* competitor research,

* weekly reporting,

* performance analysis,

* data-based recommendations,

* directing users toward free digital samples / landing pages,

* coordinating additional support if content volume grows.



Landing pages, technical automations, payment systems and product delivery will be handled by a separate specialist / team. This role focuses on community building, content, engagement and organic growth.



Content Style



We are looking for content that feels:



* intriguing,

* reflective,

* spiritual,

* premium,

* emotional,

* calm but engaging,

* mature,

* not childish,

* not cheap horoscope-style,

* not generic wellness content,

* not low-effort Canva posting.



The content should capture attention, but it should also build trust, curiosity and a sense of depth.



We do not want cheap clickbait. We want content that can stop people from scrolling while still feeling meaningful and credible.



Expected Working Style



We are not looking for someone who only “makes posts.”



We are looking for someone who can:



* test different formats quickly,

* understand what is working,

* create curiosity and emotional connection,

* combine spiritual themes with modern social media growth,

* think about the audience, the funnel and lead generation,

* manage several profiles as part of one larger ecosystem,

* organize additional support if the project starts growing.



Paid Test



Before selecting the person for ongoing cooperation, we will run a short paid test.



The test will focus on strategy and content for several connected profile directions, but it will not require creating real accounts or publishing content.



For the paid test, we will expect:



1. Short positioning for several connected profile directions.

2. Proposed naming direction or naming refinement.

3. Content pillars for each direction.

4. Visual direction for each profile and explanation of how they can stay connected as one ecosystem.

5. Hook ideas.

6. Sample short-form video scripts.

7. One sample carousel.

8. One weekly content plan.

9. Organic lead generation ideas.

10. Short explanation of how to build community and trust in the first 30 days.

11. Metrics to track during the first month.

12. Short Loom / recorded video explaining your thinking.



The test is meant to show your thinking, content quality, visual taste, strategic approach and ability to organize the process.



Preferred test timeline: 3–5 working days after signing the test agreement and receiving the brief.



Payment, Test Budget and Growth Potential



Before choosing the final person, we will run a paid test.



Paid test budget:

$150–$200, depending on portfolio quality, experience and proposed test scope.



The test will involve preparing strategy and sample materials for several connected profile directions. It will not require creating real accounts, publishing posts or managing community comments.



The goal of the test is to evaluate thinking, quality of content, visual direction, strategy and ability to organize work.



Monthly budget for the first 3-month validation phase:

$1,000–$1,200/month for managing several connected profiles as one social media ecosystem.



The final monthly scope will depend on experience, quality, realistic content volume and which tasks you can do personally versus coordinate through support.



We are not looking at this as a standard fixed-fee posting job. This project has much larger potential than a regular social media task. If the selected person shows full commitment, speed, initiative and measurable results, we are open to a model where compensation grows with the project.



A success-based bonus / performance bonus / commission model may be possible based on real results such as:



* qualified
 opt-ins,

* landing page visits,

* free sample submissions,

* customer inquiries,

* sales attributable to organic social media,

* consistent growth of an engaged audience,

* successful scaling of content production,

* reaching agreed performance milestones.



For the right person, who treats this project as a priority and actively helps it grow, performance-based compensation may eventually become much higher than the fixed monthly base.



We are not looking for someone who does the minimum. We are looking for someone who wants to enter early, commit fully, help build the audience from zero and grow with us.



Confidentiality and Rights



Before receiving detailed information, selected candidates will be required to sign documents covering:



* confidentiality,

* intellectual property transfer,

* data protection,

* no portfolio use without written approval.



All materials created for us after payment must belong to our company, including:



* scripts,

* hooks,

* captions,

* carousels,

* graphics,

* Canva files,

* video files,

* templates,

* brand concepts,

* strategies,

* documents,

* content plans,

* prompts,

* source materials.



You may not reuse, publish, sell or show project materials without written approval.



If you use subcontractors or assistants, they must be approved by us first and must follow equivalent confidentiality and IP transfer rules.



Useful Tools



Useful tools may include:



* Canva,

* CapCut,

* Premiere Pro,

* After Effects,

* Meta Business Suite,

* TikTok,

* YouTube Shorts,

* Instagram,

*
,

* Notion,

* Google Drive,

* Loom,

* AI tools,

* scheduling tools,

* analytics tools.



You do not need to use every tool listed above, but you must be able to deliver results.



How to Apply



In the first line of your application, write:



SATELLITE



This helps us confirm that you read the full post.



Please answer the following questions clearly:



1. What is your experience in social media management and growth content?

2. Do you have experience in spirituality, wellness, reflection, astrology, relationships or emotional content?

3. Please share links to your portfolio, profiles, campaigns, videos, carousels or graphics.

4. Are you able to manage several connected profiles as one content ecosystem?

5. Which tasks do you do personally, and which tasks do you outsource or coordinate?

6. Do you have trusted assistants / editors / designers who can help if content volume grows?

7. What is the maximum weekly content volume you can realistically organize for several profiles without quality dropping?

8. How many Reels / Shorts, carousels, graphics and Stories can you manage per week?

9. What monthly compensation model do you propose for the validation stage?

10. What performance bonus / commission model would motivate you to be fully involved?

11. What would your aggressive 30-day growth plan look like?

12. Which tools do you use?

13. Can you work asynchronously through
, documents and recorded video updates?

14. Are you comfortable signing NDA, IP transfer and data protection documents?

15. How soon can you start?

16. What is your price for the paid test described above?

17. How much time do you need to complete the paid test?



Please do not apply if:



* you only create basic Canva posts,

* you do not respond reliably to messages,

* you are not ready to work on a confidential project,

* you are not willing to transfer source files and rights after payment,

* you are not ready to test, analyze and iterate quickly,

* you are looking only for a simple side task without deeper involvement.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the project.

title: CTMS Platform Builder & Technical Product Manager
description:
About Taxa Technologies



Taxa Technologies is a biotech startup developing microbiome-based therapeutics for skin health. We run decentralized clinical trials (DCT) with at-home participants across multiple concurrent study formats — in-person, hybrid, and fully remote. We need a hands-on builder to own our Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) platform end-to-end — replacing our current third-party system and building a custom platform from completing the current prototype through full production hardening.





The Role



We're looking for a full-stack developer who doubles as a technical product manager to take ownership of our CTMS platform. You'll work with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) alongside strong engineering fundamentals to ship features fast, manage the product roadmap, and handle deployment.



This is not a "write specs and hand off" PM role. You will build, ship, and deploy — with AI tools accelerating code generation while you provide the architecture, security judgment, and quality control.



The system has two main portals:

• Study Admin Portal — for Taxa staff (coordinators, PIs, operations)

• Participant Portal — mobile-first interface for study participants





What You'll Own



You will help scale and productionize Taxa’s clinical operations platform and next-generation CTMS infrastructure across participant logistics, study coordination, compliance workflows, and automation systems.



Key areas of ownership may include:



* Building and maintaining participant-facing workflows and internal operational tools

* Designing secure systems for kit activation, participant tracking, and clinical data handling

* Developing coordinator workflows, reporting tools, and operational dashboards

* Improving communication systems, notifications, and participant engagement infrastructure

* Supporting compliance, auditability, and operational reliability requirements

* Contributing to the evolution of Taxa’s CTMS architecture and operational data systems

* Collaborating on infrastructure, security, and platform scalability decisions as the system evolves

* Exploring intelligent automation and AI-assisted operational workflows



This role requires strong product-minded engineering judgment, comfort operating in ambiguity, and the ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions in a fast-moving environment.





Required Skills



• Full-stack development — backend-heavy (API design, database, integrations), comfortable with server-rendered frontends

• HIPAA / healthcare data handling — experience with PHI storage, encryption requirements, audit trails, and BAA chains. Must be able to articulate your approach to HIPAA compliance in the proposal

• Clinical trial or healthtech experience — prior work with participant management, DCT workflows, CTMS/EDC systems, or regulated software (21 CFR Part 11, GxP, or equivalent)

• AI-assisted development proficiency — experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, or similar AI coding tools. You should be meaningfully faster with AI tools than without them

• Deployment & DevOps — experience with containerized deployments (Fly.io, Railway, AWS, or similar). Comfortable managing infrastructure

• API integration — shipping APIs, payment APIs (Stripe), SMS/email providers (Twilio, SendGrid)

• Product thinking — ability to translate a phase roadmap into sprint-level tasks, make scope trade-offs, and communicate progress clearly

• Security architecture — understanding of token management, endpoint security, encryption at rest/in transit, and data protection

• Clean, documented, peer-reviewable code — another engineer must be able to take over without a full rewrite





Preferred Skills



• Prior CTMS, EDC, or ePRO system experience (Medidata, Veeva, OpenClinica, or similar)

• PostgreSQL — for the Phase 4 migration

• Python or TypeScript — primary languages of the platform

• AWS or GCP infrastructure experience (IaC preferred)

• Decentralized / remote clinical trial experience

• QR/barcode tracking system experience

• Video call / telehealth integration experience (future phase)

• Can manage a second engineer if scope requires it





Third-Party Services (Integrate, Not Build)



The following must be provided via third-party services with HIPAA BAA coverage:

• Authentication: Auth0, Cognito, or equivalent

• HIPAA-compliant data storage: AWS, GCP, or Azure with signed BAA

• E-signature / eConsent: DocuSign, HelloSign, or equivalent

•
 delivery: SendGrid, Postmark, or equivalent

• SMS: Twilio or equivalent

• Shipping + tracking: Carrier API (Shippo, FedEx, UPS, USPS)

• Payment processing: Stripe or equivalent

• Video calls (future phase): Twilio Video, Daily.co, or HIPAA-compliant service





Key Constraints



• HIPAA compliance from Phase 1 — PHI must be stored in a HIPAA-equivalent environment from day one. Cannot be retrofitted

• Architecture must support video — Phase 1 must be built so a dermatologist video consultation module can be added later without a full rebuild

• Study data isolation — data from different studies must be isolatable at the database level, not just in the UI

• Scalability — must support thousands of participants across concurrent studies

• All participant communication inside the system — IRB and HIPAA compliance requires no external channels (Slack, Discord, etc.) for participant comms

• Jeeva replacement timeline — contract renewal decision in August 2026. Build plan must account for this deadline





How You'll Work



• Primary tools: AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), GitHub, Fly.io / AWS

• Communication: Async via Slack + weekly sync calls

• Reporting: To Clinical Operations lead (Luma Melo) + co-founder (Yuichi Fukunaga). A part-time engineer in Japan will conduct code reviews

• Autonomy: High. You own the roadmap execution. We set priorities together; you decide how to build

• AI-augmented workflow: We expect you to leverage AI tools to move fast. The role is designed around a single senior person + AI being more effective than a traditional 3-person team

• Deliverable-based: Scope-of-work contract with clear deliverables per phase





To Apply



Send us:

1. A brief intro (2-3 sentences about your background)

2. A link to a project you built or shipped (GitHub, live product, or case study) — preferably in healthcare/regulated software

3. Your experience with AI coding tools — which ones, how you use them, and an example of what you shipped with them

4. Your approach to HIPAA compliance — how you've handled PHI in past projects (1-2 paragraphs)

5. Hourly rate and weekly availability

6. (Optional) A phased delivery proposal with rough time and cost estimates based on this brief

, Instagram, LinkedIn) using pattern interrupts and personalized messaging.

title: AMAZON ACCOUNT MANAGER / ADMIN VA
description:
AMAZON ACCOUNT MANAGER / ADMIN VA



ABOUT US



We are a growing UK-based e-commerce business operating primarily through Amazon FBA using Online Arbitrage (OA) and Wholesale business models.



Our focus is on building long-term, scalable operations with strong systems, reliable processes and continuous growth. We work with suppliers, prep centers, Amazon Seller Support and internal systems daily across a wide range of operational and account management tasks.



We are looking for a dedicated, accountable and solution-oriented Amazon Account Manager / Admin VA to join our business long term.



This is NOT just a basic VA role.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow, deeply understand systems, solve problems independently and become an important part of the business.



We are also looking for someone seeking a stable long-term position and not juggling multiple full-time roles simultaneously.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



* Monitor Account Health and Performance Notifications daily

* Handle and fix compliance-related issues

* Fix search suppressions

* Handle hazmat review issues

* Handle stranded inventory issues

* Communicate with Amazon Seller Support through cases

* Follow up unresolved issues until solved

* Gather and organize invoices/documents for Amazon requests

* Monitor slow-moving inventory and suggest removal decisions when necessary

* Create removal orders

* Set and manage max prices

* Communicate daily with prep centers

* Communicate with suppliers

* List products correctly

* Keep systems and spreadsheets organized

* Handle ad-hoc operational and administrative tasks when needed

* Immediately report problems, delays, blockers or important issues

* Maintain proactive and consistent communication

* Be continuously available during working hours

* Report important updates, risks and problems to the owner



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone who is:



* Eager to learn

* Honest and accountable

* Dedicated and hardworking

* Highly responsive during work hours

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Calm under pressure

* Able to think independently

* Solution-oriented

* Proactive in finding and following up issues

* Interested in long-term growth

* Comfortable communicating in English



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with the following is a big advantage:



* Amazon Seller Central

* FBA workflows

* Compliance issues

* Hazmat

* Search suppressions

* Product listings

* Google Sheets / Excel

* BuyBotPro

* Reading and understanding Keepa charts

* SellerToolkit



We also value people who can quickly adapt to new systems and workflows.



WORKING STYLE EXPECTATIONS



This role requires proactive communication and ownership mentality.



We expect issues, delays or blockers to be reported immediately rather than waiting to be asked.



Reliable internet connection and strong written English communication skills are important for this role.



SALARY STRUCTURE



* Initial salary during training/probation period (1–3 months) starts from £200/month

* Salary increases based on performance, independence, reliability and overall contribution to the business



There is also potential for future raises and leadership opportunities for exceptional performance.



IMPORTANT



We value:



* Accountability

* Responsiveness

* Ownership mentality

* Proactive communication

* People who focus on solutions instead of excuses



We are looking for someone who wants to grow together with a serious long-term business.



HOW TO APPLY



To confirm that you carefully read the full job post, include the word “ownership” somewhere in your application.



Please also briefly describe:



* A difficult Amazon-related issue you solved before

* How you approached it

* What the final outcome was



Please include:



* Your Amazon-related experience

* Tools you used

* Your availability

* Why you think you are a good fit for this role

title: Senior Real Estate Appraisal Coordinator
description:
**ONLY APPLY VIA THE LINK PROVIDED BELOW. DM'S SENT ON ONLINE JOBS WILL NOT BE RESPONDED TO**



If you’ve worked inside a US Appraisal Management Company and you know the difference between a 1004 and a Field Review, a TAT and a due date extension, an ENB file and a standard PDF delivery — this role was written for you.

We’re not looking for someone we need to teach the industry. We’re looking for someone who already speaks it fluently and is ready to own it.



Senior Appraisal Coordinator



Company: Pahroo Appraisal and Consultancy, LLC - Chicago USA.

Location: Remote (US hours)

Type: Full-Time

Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST, Monday to Friday

Salary: PHP 55,000 – PHP 95,000



ABOUT PAHROO

PahRoo Appraisal & Consultancy LLC is a Chicago-based real estate appraisal firm operating across residential and commercial markets in Illinois and Texas. We work with AMCs, direct lenders, and private clients, and we are growing — deliberately and with the right people.



We run a ROWE culture: Results Only Work Environment. We don’t count hours. We count outcomes. If you’re a professional who delivers without being micromanaged, you’ll thrive here.



THE ROLE

This is a senior front office position with real ownership. You will be the operational engine of our Appraisal Operations Department — the person who keeps orders moving, clients updated, appraisers scheduled, and nothing falling through the cracks.



You’ll work directly with our Appraisal Operations Manager, hold independent decision-making authority on day-to-day coordination, and play a hands-on role in shaping how our front office runs as we scale.



This is not a task-ticker role. It is a thinking role for someone who takes pride in running a tight operation.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

– Full order lifecycle management across ANOW — from bid acceptance through report delivery and closure

– Independent bid decisions on standard residential assignments; zero waiting on someone else to move your queue

– Inspection scheduling and appraiser route optimization for our Chicago and Dallas markets

– Outreach calling and pipeline management across our AMC and direct client accounts

– Report delivery via AMC portals in all required formats — PDF, XML, ENB

– Revision management end-to-end — you communicate, you track, you close

– Zoho CRM ownership for outreach tracking and lead pipeline management

– Keeping ANOW audit-ready at all times — data integrity is non-negotiable here



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

– Minimum 2 years of experience in a US AMC, appraisal office, or appraisal management environment — this is a hard requirement, not a preference

– Working knowledge of US residential appraisal order types: 1004/URAR, FHA, Field Review, New Construction, Desktop

– Hands-on experience with ANOW or a comparable appraisal CRM (Mercury Network, Appraisal Inbox, etc.)

– Professional written and spoken English — you are client-facing from day one

– The ability to manage 20+ active orders simultaneously without losing your composure or your accuracy

– Availability to work full CST business hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday

– CRM experience in Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent is a strong advantage



WHAT YOU GET

– PHP 55,000–95,000/month commensurate with experience — a senior rate for a senior hire

– Full-time, long-term contractor engagement — this is a career position, not a project

– Direct access to a senior leadership team actively investing in the right systems and the right people

– Deep, specialized expertise in the US appraisal market — one of the most defensible and transferable skill sets in offshore real estate operations

– A ROWE culture — your results define your day, not a timesheet



START DATE

Immediate. We are moving quickly on this hire and interviewing on a rolling basis. If you are the right person, we will not wait.

title: Commercial Real Estate Appraisal Analyst
description:
**IMPORTANT**

To apply for this role, only use this link:





Direct messages via onlinejobs.ph are not accepted.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Location: Remote (US hours)    



Type: Full-Time



Hours: 4:00 AM – 1:00 PM CST, Monday to Friday



Salary: PHP 80,000 – PHP 110,000 (PHP 100,000 – PHP 140,000 for MAI candidacy or proven US CRE track record)



 



About Pahroo



Pahroo Appraisal and Consultancy delivers commercial real estate valuations and advisory services across US markets, with a focus on assets underlying debt and equity investments. We work across office, industrial, multifamily, self-storage, and retail. The team is small, the work is rigorous, and the standards are high.



Working Hours — Please Read Before Applying

This role operates on US Central Standard Time: 4:00 AM – 1:00 PM CST, Monday to Friday. If you are based outside the US, please confirm this works for your circumstances before applying. It is a firm requirement.



The Role



You will sit within the valuation team, producing and supporting appraisal reports across a mixed commercial portfolio. The work is analytical, deadline-driven, and detail-critical. Once onboarded, you will be expected to work with a real degree of independence, drawing on sound US market knowledge to produce defensible value conclusions.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands why a number is what it is, not just how to arrive at it.



What You Will Do



 - Conduct research using industry databases — CoStar, REIS, RCA, PwC Real Estate Investor Survey, and broker market reports — to gather and interrogate comparable market evidence

 - Analyse property-level financial data including income statements, rent rolls, reimbursement schedules, and occupancy statistics to develop well-supported value indicators

 - Prepare collateral monitoring reports for assets underlying debt and equity investments across office, industrial, multifamily, self-storage, retail, and other property types

 - Produce USPAP-compliant appraisal reports ready for lender, investor, or regulatory review

 - Identify data gaps and market anomalies; flag assumptions that materially affect value conclusions

 - Manage competing report deadlines accurately without compromising on quality

 



What We Need



Required



 - Minimum 5 years of commercial real estate appraisal or valuation experience

 - Demonstrated, hands-on experience in the US property market — no learning curve on market fundamentals

 - Proficiency in ANOW, Total, and Excel-based valuation modelling

 - Working knowledge of USPAP requirements and their practical application in report preparation

 - Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, or a closely related field

 - Strong written English — reports require clear, accurate, and defensible reasoning

 



Advantageous



 - MAI designation (Appraisal Institute) or active candidacy

 - RICS membership — relevant for internationally-based candidates with demonstrable US market exposure

 - Familiarity with CoStar, REIS, or RCA analytics platforms

 - Experience across two or more distinct asset classes

 



What We Offer



 - Base salary PHP 80,000 – PHP 110,000 per month

 - PHP 100,000 – PHP 140,000 for candidates with MAI candidacy or a demonstrable US CRE track record across multiple asset classes — we pay up for the right experience

 - Fully remote position

 - Clear onboarding with defined expectations from day one

title: Video Editor (Paid Ad Creatives)
description:
Hey there! We're Hest Enterprises — an eCommerce brand that is scaling globally.



We're looking for a Junior Video Editor to join our fast growing team.



Your mission? Collaborate with our Creative Strategist & Copywriter to produce ad creatives that actually convert and help scale our brands to multiple 7 figures+.



Important! If you have zero interest in learning why ads work (not just making them look pretty), this role isn't for you. But if you're hungry to learn marketing while sharpening your editing skills...



Who We're Looking For



One golden rule at our company: you must have the DESIRE to learn & grow. If you're not passionate about getting better every week, this isn't the place for you.



The purpose of this role isn't just editing videos — it's learning how to edit for performance. You'll learn how hooks grab attention, how emotional pacing drives watch time, and how the right angle maximizes ROAS. We'll train you on the marketing side — you bring the hunger.



You're a great fit if you:



- Love editing videos and want to get seriously good at it

- Are curious about what makes ads actually convert

- Take feedback well and move fast on revisions

- Are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

- Want to grow into a Creative Strategist role over time (not necessary)



What You'll Do Day-to-Day



- Edit short-form video ads (UGC, product clips, b-roll)

- Assemble ads using provided scripts, briefs, and reference examples

- Add text overlays, captions, cuts, and pacing optimized for ads

- Create variations from the same core footage for testing

- Help document ad structure in simple briefs (hook, message, CTA)

- Make revisions based on internal feedback

- Keep files and exports organized for the team

- Attend weekly learning check-ins



Required:



- Experience with Video Editing ads (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar)

- Clear written English

- Ability to follow instructions and hit deadlines

- Open & Curious to Feedback and Revisions

- Organised and reliable



Why Join Us?



- Bonuses & Profit Share — You'll earn bonuses tied to the performance of ads you help create. When your work converts, you get rewarded.

- Real Training — Not just video editing. We'll train you on ad structures, creative strategy, and how to edit for results. You'll learn marketing fundamentals most junior editors never get exposed to.

- Growth Path — There's a clear path from Junior Editor ? Creative Strategist based on performance. We promote from within.



How Does This Work?



We hold our team to high standards and reward great work — expect your rates to grow as you do. Here's our simple hiring process:



- Send a short intro video about yourself and your experience,

- A portfolio or samples of video edits (ads preferred)

- Culture and Values Interview

- Complete a quick editing assessment tailored for the role

- Final interview with our Founder to discuss fit and finalize an offer



If this resonates with you, let's chat! Choose the number of the core value you feel aligns with you most and include it in your application:



1 - RESULTS OBSESSED

2 - ATTENTION TO DETAIL

3 - ACCELERATED EXCELLENCE

4 - RELENTLESS OWNERSHIP

5 - PREPARED TO WIN

6 - COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION

7 - NEVER NOT GROWING



Apply now and let's grow together!

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication for client and contractor coordination.

What We Offer

Immediate start, as early as today.
